title: Night traffic: elephant herd
storyboard: Film: our camera-trap clip of an elephant herd crossing a forest track near Bengaluru, 15 s

scenes.headline: The night traffic on our trail.
Elephants eat at night too
scenes.body: Asian elephants have three main feeding bouts: early morning, afternoon and night.

scenes.headline: Count the herd: mostly females
scenes.body: Herds are small groups of related females with their young.

scenes.label: Asian elephants estimated in the wild

caption:
Our camera trap logged the herd before we ever saw it.

Asian elephants tend to rest and nap through the hottest hours of the day, and feed again at night.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo, Asian elephant. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Storyboard: CC photos stand in for our camera-trap clip; 'count the herd' gives viewers a task. Low-risk original format once we have our own trap footage.
